model.description: Another model of the same provider and account: an id from `models` or its name ("opus 5.5"). Default: the thread's.

requestId.description: Any stable id; repeating a call with it runs once.

runId.description: Fork after this finished run. Default: the latest finished one.

text.description: The fork's first message: the other approach, standing on its own.

threadId.description: The thread to fork. Default: this thread.
